simple.meaning: תִּימָרָה (tîymârâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a column , i.e. cloud.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תִּימָרָה (H8490) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 3:6, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Joel.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תִּימָרָה (H8490) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תִּימָרָה (tîymârâh) / H8490 is traced through Song of Songs 3:6, Joel 3:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
